snippet.title: Plum Road Tea Dream Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Discover seven sanctuaries and delve into the pain & joy of S.’s life as a queer person of color. Create animistic gods through a futuristic machine. Embark on a quest to manifest the Sword of Sadness. Find rest, sanctuary and comfort. Can you help S. complete their transformative ritual?

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206340/Plum_Road_Tea_Dream/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
